title: Buyer-cost-first current private-market event scan
purpose: Stop mechanism-first opportunity generation. Bind a named current Xuzhou/Jiangsu private actor to an observed economic cost first; only then inspect the current workaround, incumbents and any post-incumbent missing edge.
scan_rule: NAMED COST EVENT != OPEN ROUTING GAP
Do not promote from a provider price list or a plausible mechanism.
A candidate requires a named current actor, observed cost or workaround, and an observed post-incumbent missing edge.

bound_cost_events.actor: 徐州科亚机电有限公司
bound_cost_events.observed_cost_event: The company reported that overseas orders for its self-developed wireless controller exceeded what it could fulfill, and it gave up part of those overseas orders in order to preserve on-time delivery.
observed_workaround: Internal product/process redesign increased output from roughly 200 units/hour for the prior wired controller to roughly 800-900 units/hour for the wireless controller.
Despite that internal throughput improvement, public reporting still states that part of overseas demand was declined.
current_market_context: Fengxian currently has more than 1,400 complete-vehicle and parts manufacturers.
The local cluster reports a 30-minute procurement circle for almost all vehicle parts except chips.
Local controller and electric-vehicle manufacturers publicly advertise manufacturing, customization, private-label or sample-based processing capability.
bound_cost_events.constraint_note: These possible constraints are hypotheses only. No current public evidence found in this scan proves which one, if any, prevents overflow production from being routed to existing local capacity.

attributable_findings: Current public materials confirm Keya operates a deeply integrated in-house controller manufacturing and quality stack, including SMT/placement, wave soldering, automated test capability and automotive quality-system claims.
Current public reporting confirms a dense Fengxian vehicle/parts cluster and nearby alternative manufacturing capability.

No attributable public evidence found in this audit states that Keya attempted subcontracting/second-source production and was blocked, refused it for a stated reason, or faced a named IP/quality/certification/component constraint that prevents overflow routing.

bound_cost_events.actor: 江苏本优机械有限公司
bound_cost_events.observed_cost_event: A large-diameter liquid flowmeter previously had to be removed and shipped to Nanjing or farther for verification; the round trip took roughly half a month, stopping the production line and delaying orders.
bound_cost_events.observed_workaround: Off-site instrument verification requiring removal and transport.
bound_cost_events.current_solution: The Xuzhou Inspection and Testing Center obtained local full-range verification capability and performed on-site calibration without shutdown or removal.

bound_cost_events.actor: 江苏弘盛新材料（集团）股份有限公司
bound_cost_events.observed_cost_event: Export logistics previously cost about RMB 4,100 per container; the current rail route lowers it to about RMB 2,700 for roughly 100 containers per month.
bound_cost_events.observed_savings: More than RMB 100,000 per month reported.

bound_cost_events.actor: 江苏金洲粮油食品有限公司
bound_cost_events.observed_cost_event: The company described the prior all-road route from Shanghai Port as high-cost and exposed to port congestion and complicated transfer procedures.
bound_cost_events.observed_savings: About RMB 5 million of logistics cost saved in 2025 after switching to the current water route.
bound_cost_events.current_solution: Existing Shanghai Port to Hai'an inland-waterway route via Fengshan Port.

bound_cost_events.actor: 江苏鹏飞集团股份有限公司
bound_cost_events.observed_cost_event: Direct road transport of shield-machine forgings to Shanghai Port was reported as expensive.
bound_cost_events.observed_savings: Current water route reduced a large-container transport cost from about RMB 3,000 to RMB 1,800, around 40%.

rejected_weak_evidence_classes.class: anonymous buyer case in provider marketing copy
provider capability or price list without a named buyer cost event
named cost event already eliminated by a current incumbent route

material_learning: Buyer-cost-first produces materially stronger evidence than mechanism-first scanning because it starts from observed economic pressure.
A named actor losing orders is still not an opportunity until the reason existing capacity, suppliers or platforms cannot absorb the overflow is observed.
Keya's foregone overseas orders are real, but the targeted residual audit found no attributable public evidence of a post-incumbent routing barrier.
Integrated manufacturing, patents, quality systems or strong in-house process capability cannot be converted into an outsourcing barrier by inference alone.
Several other named cost events were real but already closed by current institutional or multimodal routes.
cross_industry_result.current_best_next_truth: Close the Keya observation fail-closed and start Fresh Scan 025 under the same BUYER COST FIRST rule. Search new current Xuzhou/Jiangsu private-market events; require a named actor plus observed economic cost and an observed post-incumbent missing edge before any candidate is retained.
